description: Everyone local knows something the player does not. No mechanical effect at all: a room full of people who have decided to be elsewhere.
name: Everything shuts early

lines: Another shutter comes down. It's nowhere near closing time.
The place three doors along has gone dark and locked, mid-afternoon.
Two people are having a very short conversation about whether to stay open.

stage.text: Half of {place} shut up at four. They know something and they aren't saying it to me.
A shutter comes rattling down somewhere close.
